== ''Usage'' ==
Hijacked Iron tools have a few abilities:
* Applies [[Bleeding]] to attacked entities
* Deal additional damage to all [[Mobs|Parasites]], [[Assimilated Mobs]], and [[Hijacked Mobs]]
* Applies [[Rage]] to the wielder when nearing death (threshold not known)
* Have a max durability equal to Diamond tools
Hijacked Iron tools are otherwise identical to regular Iron tools.
